wx: Roann-Paw Paw Township Public Library is a historic Carnegie library building located at Roann, Indiana. It was built in 1916, and is a one-story, rectangular, American Craftsman style brick building over a semi-recessed basement.

wx: Thomas J. Lewis House is a historic home located at Roann, Indiana. It was built about 1903, and is a 2+1⁄2-story, Queen Anne style frame dwelling.

Stockdale Mill, also known as the Roann Roller Mill, is a historic grist mill building located in Paw Paw Township, Wabash County, Indiana. It was built between 1855 and 1857, and is a 3+1⁄2-story, post and beam frame mill building.
